data.name: Anzurat
data.gender_notes: Anzurat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of God meaning the one who protects, defends and preserves. The name Anzurat carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Anzurat usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl believed to bring protection, safety and security.
data.etymology: Anzurat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anzurat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أنزurat
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أنزurat مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ن-ز-ر، و يعني الرفعة و العزة و الارتفاع في المقام، و يوحي بالشرف و المكانة العالية، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني سامية و رفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: انزورات
in_urdu.long_meaning: انزورات نام عربی زبان کے ن-ز-ر جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عزت، رفعت، اور مقام کی بلندی، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اعلیٰ مقام اور شرف کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں اس کا استعمال روایتی اور روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अंजुरात
in_hindi.long_meaning: अंजुरात नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के न-ज़-र मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सम्मान, ऊंचाई और प्रतिष्ठा, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में उच्च नैतिक मूल्यों और आध्यात्मिक महत्व को दर्शाता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग पारंपरिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है.

in_pashto.name: انزورات
in_pashto.long_meaning: انزورات نوم د عربي ژبې د ن-ز-ر ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د عزت، لوړتیا، او د مقام لوړوالی دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو او مذهبي کړاوو کې د لوړو موخو او معنوي ارزښتونو ښکارندوی دی.

in_english.name: Anzurat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anzurat is derived from the Arabic root n-z-r, meaning elevation, dignity, and high esteem, it connotes nobility and high standing in Islamic tradition, reflecting spiritual and moral excellence, and is used across various Muslim cultures to signify prestige and respect.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anzurat holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community, especially in the context of seeking protection and safety. In many Islamic traditions and cultures, the invocation of Anzurat is used during times of danger, distress, or spiritual need. It is believed that by invoking the name of Allah as Anzurat, one can find solace, strength, and rescue in times of difficulty.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Anzurat underscores the protective and caring nature of Allah as the ultimate guardian and provider. It highlights the belief that Allah is ever-present and always prepared to shield His creations from harm. In times of despair or uncertainty, the remembrance of Allah as Anzurat serves as a source of comfort and inspiration, reminding us of the Divine love, care, and protection that we constantly receive from the Creator.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector" symbolizes A name of God meaning the one who protects, defends and preserves.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Anzurat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Anzurat was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari. The name Anzurat carried significant weight in that era.
